# Test UP to see if target moves vertically
print("Testing UP...")
action(['UP'])

# Check what changed
before = last_transition.before_frame
after = last_transition.after_frame
before_ascii = before.ascii.split('\n')
after_ascii = after.ascii.split('\n')

changed = []
for r in range(64):
    for c in range(min(len(before_ascii[r]), len(after_ascii[r]))):
        if before_ascii[r][c] != after_ascii[r][c]:
            changed.append((r, c, before_ascii[r][c], after_ascii[r][c]))

changed_by_row = {}
for r, c, b, a in changed:
    if r not in changed_by_row:
        changed_by_row[r] = []
    changed_by_row[r].append((c, b, a))

for r in sorted(changed_by_row.keys()):
    cells = changed_by_row[r]
    print(f"Row {r}: {cells[:10]}")

# Check current target position
print("\n=== Target area after UP ===")
for r in range(40, 52):
    line = after_ascii[r][38:50]
    if 'O' in line or 'b' in line:
        print(f"Row {r}: {line}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
